scope: Uniform orientation; rotation axis uniform on sphere, speed 2–12 rad/s; CG height 6–20 m; vertical speed −4 to +5 m/s; horizontal velocity 5 m/s; 400 kg full tank; clear ground. All 200 cases count, including failures. This distribution is not a measured distribution of driving incidents.
recoveryCriterion: Before any wheel or body contact: tilt <10 degrees and angular speed <0.5 rad/s in at least one sampled frame.
landingCriterion: Existing driving success: one second of stable tire support, no hard/body contact; unchanged thresholds.
